tool_input.command:
git add internal/mission/active.go internal/mission/active_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): stable-sort + symlink-reject in ReadDispatchPending (L5)

Review finding L5 (full-branch review, m-2026-09-08-004 round 3), two
issues in one function:

1. ReadDispatchPending sorted purely on CreatedAt (mtime) with
   sort.Slice, whose ordering is documented as unspecified for equal
   comparator keys -- and mtime ties are real (coarse filesystem mtime
   resolution, two writers landing in the same tick). Extracted the
   comparator to dispatchPendingLess and added a MissionID tiebreak
   (IDs are date-sequential, so lexical order is creation order) plus
   switched to SliceStable. The comparator is tested directly rather
   than through the filesystem: os.ReadDir already returns entries
   sorted by filename, which coincides with mission-ID order for this
   repo's ID scheme, so a filesystem-backed test cannot distinguish
   "correctly tiebroken" from "already alphabetical by luck" -- exactly
   the reliance on an incidental implementation detail this finding
   flags.

2. Every other sidecar reader in this package refuses a symlinked entry
   (LoadDelegation's rejectSymlink) before reading it; this one read
   straight through os.ReadFile, which follows symlinks. Added the same
   rejectSymlink call before the read.

Both regression tests confirmed failing against pre-fix code: the
symlink test via git-stash falsification, the tiebreak test via a
targeted revert of dispatchPendingLess to its bare mtime-only form.
EOF
)"
